research_notes: A later state schema can track per-class counters clean_pass, duration_fail, non_duration_fail, and under_target directly.
That would make the decision rule executable without scanning all history on every run.
The counters should be derived/updated only from immutable classified evidence to avoid drift.
Supporting evidence should have separate counters or references.
This is a small observability improvement consistent with the research goal.
It can be implemented after the current timing-sensitive run closes.
